The way to reach the village can be a bit tricky but you can spot it on google maps and the most traditional way of navigation which is ‘ask the villagers’. It may seem like what’s new in a village? Well, there is a hill which is Raayta hill and that is the main point of attraction. From the top of the Hill
reportedBestTime: Monsoon (July to September) for lush greenery & flowing water
directionsNote: Accessible by scooter, taxi or private car.
